rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to say that a bird is perched or resting on a support.

example.english: The bird will perch on the branch to rest.
example.traditional: 隻雀停喺樹枝上面休息。
example.jyutping: zek3 zoek3 ting4 hai2 syu6 zi1 soeng6 min6 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when the bird is visibly standing on the support, rather than merely stopping there.

example.english: The parrot continues to perch on the stand.
example.jyutping: zek3 jing1 mou5 kei5 hai2 gaa3 soeng6 min6

rows.note: Use this for the Perca fish sense rather than for a bird's roost or a figurative position.

example.english: We caught a perch by the lake yesterday.
example.traditional: 我哋尋日喺湖邊釣到一條鱸魚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cam4 jat6 hai2 wu4 bin1 diu3 dou3 jat1 tiu4 lou4 jyu2

rows.note: Use this for a secure or advantageous position, especially in a figurative context.

example.english: From this advantageous perch, we can see the whole field clearly.
example.traditional: 企喺呢個有利位置，我哋睇得清楚成個球場。
example.jyutping: kei5 hai2 ni1 go3 jau5 lei6 wai6 zi3 ngo5 dei6 tai2 dak1 cing1 co2 sing4 go3 kau4 coeng4

rows.note: Use this when someone places an object on a perch or other support.

example.english: I perch the flower vase on the windowsill.
example.traditional: 我將個花樽放喺窗台上面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 go3 faa1 zeon1 fong3 hai2 coeng1 toi1 soeng6 min6

rows.note: Use this technical noun for the rod or branch where a caged or domestic bird perches.

example.english: The vet suggested adding a perch to the birdcage so the bird could rest.
example.traditional: 獸醫建議喺雀籠入面加條棲木，方便雀仔休息。
example.jyutping: sau3 ji1 gin3 ji5 hai2 zoek3 lung4 jap6 min6 gaa1 tiu4 cai1 muk6 fong1 bin6 zoek3 zai2 jau1 sik1
